title: Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Amendment Ordinance 2004

sections.shortTitle: Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Amendment Ordinance 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE III OF 2004
ORDINANCE III OF
2004
LEGAL
PRACTITIONERS AND BAR COUNCILS (AMENDMENT), ORDINANCE, 2004
An Ordinance
further to amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 3rd November, 2004]
No. F. 2 (1)/2004‑Pub.,
dated 3‑11‑2004.‑--The following Ordinance promulgated by
the President is hereby published for general information.
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And Whereas the National Assembly
is not' in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, Therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title, and
commencement etc.--‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Legal
Practitioners and Bar Councils (Amendment) Ordinance, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
(3) The provisions of this
Ordinance shall have effect notwithstanding anything contained in any other law
or rules for the time being in force.

Amendment of section 2, Act XXXV of 1973

Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Legal Practitioners and Bar Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973), for
the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And Whereas the National Assembly
is not' in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, Therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate
the following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2, Act
XXXV of 1973.‑‑‑In the Legal Practitioners and Bar
Councils Act, 1973 (XXXV of 1973'), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in
section 2,‑‑‑‑
(1) clause (cc)
shall be omitted;
(2) for clause
(e), the following shall be substituted, namely.‑‑‑
"(e)
`Legal practitioner' means an advocate;";
(3)
after clause (k), the following new clauses shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"(kk) `roll of group of
districts' means a roll of advocates of a High Court or, as the case may be, a
roll of advocates practicing in a former Revenue Division as existed on the
31st December, 1999, prepared and maintained by a Provincial Bar. Council under
this Act;
(kkk) `Schedule' means Schedule
to this act;" and
(4) in clause (n), for the full
stop at the end the semi‑colon shall be substituted and thereafter the
following new clause shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(o)
`voter' means‑‑‑
(i) in relation
to election to a Provincial Bar Council, an advocate whose name for the time
being appears on the roll, of group of districts and. to whom an identity card
has been issued by a Provincial Bar Council and who is not in arrears of dues
of the Provincial Bar Council for a period exceeding six months; and
(ii) in relation
to election to the Pakistan Bar Council, a member of a Provincial Bar.
Council."

(2) The number of members to be
